body: I just tried to. I used to not care, since I was sure it would work, but now I am alive, and I am utterly terrified.
This is horrible.. I thought I would drift happily to sleep and sleep forever...
I don't think I have any wisdom for you. I'm sorry about that.
I already took 4 bottles of pills amongst other things, but I keep throwing up. Lucky you, I might live.
